items.q: What does it cost to paint a house on Mercer Island?

a.text: Mercer Island exteriors typically run $6,000 to $14,000 — higher than the Eastside average, and for structural reasons rather than zip-code pricing. Island homes skew larger, many are two- and three-story, and a significant share are mid-century properties with cedar or board-and-batten siding that needs real preparation rather than a quick wash.
a.html: Mercer Island exteriors typically run $6,000 to $14,000 — higher than the Eastside average, and for structural reasons rather than zip-code pricing. Island homes skew larger, many are two- and three-story, and a significant share are mid-century properties with cedar or board-and-batten siding that needs real preparation rather than a quick wash.

a.text: Waterfront and view properties carry additional cost because of exposure. Homes facing Lake Washington take sustained wind-driven moisture and UV on one elevation, which is why we often specify a higher-grade coating called “Emerald Rain Refresh” from Sherwin Williams.
a.html: Waterfront and view properties carry additional cost because of exposure. Homes facing Lake Washington take sustained wind-driven moisture and UV on one elevation, which is why we often specify a higher-grade coating called “Emerald Rain Refresh” from Sherwin Williams.

items.q: Do you paint waterfront and lakefront homes?

a.text: Yes, and they are a different job than an inland repaint. Constant moisture, wind-driven rain, and reflected UV off the water break down standard coatings faster on the exposed elevations.
a.html: Yes, and they are a different job than an inland repaint. Constant moisture, wind-driven rain, and reflected UV off the water break down standard coatings faster on the exposed elevations.

a.text: On lakefront work we specify 100% acrylic systems rated for severe exposure, pay particular attention to sealing horizontal surfaces and end grain where water sits, and prime any bare wood the same day it is exposed rather than leaving it open overnight. We also plan access early — many Island waterfront lots have limited ladder footing on the lake side, and that affects both schedule and cost.
a.html: On lakefront work we specify 100% acrylic systems rated for severe exposure, pay particular attention to sealing horizontal surfaces and end grain where water sits, and prime any bare wood the same day it is exposed rather than leaving it open overnight. We also plan access early — many Island waterfront lots have limited ladder footing on the lake side, and that affects both schedule and cost.

items.q: My home was built before 1978. Does that change anything?

a.text: Yes, and it matters legally as well as practically. Homes built before 1978 may contain lead-based paint, and any contractor disturbing painted surfaces in one is required by the EPA to be Lead-Safe Renovation, Repair and Painting (RRP) certified. That means containment, specific work practices, and proper cleanup and disposal.
a.html: Yes, and it matters legally as well as practically. Homes built before 1978 may contain lead-based paint, and any contractor disturbing painted surfaces in one is required by the EPA to be Lead-Safe Renovation, Repair and Painting (RRP) certified. That means containment, specific work practices, and proper cleanup and disposal.

a.text: A meaningful share of Mercer Island housing stock predates 1978. You should get your home tested before reaching out to us. If it has lead, you should find a lead certification painting company that specializes in this. If not, give us a call.

items.q: How do you protect mature trees and landscaping during exterior work?

a.text: Mercer Island lots are heavily planted, often with established rhododendrons, Japanese maples, and mature evergreens close to the structure — which is exactly where ladders and drop cloths want to go.
a.html: Mercer Island lots are heavily planted, often with established rhododendrons, Japanese maples, and mature evergreens close to the structure — which is exactly where ladders and drop cloths want to go.

a.text: We tie back rather than cut, use breathable drop cloths so plants underneath are not cooked or suffocated over a multi-day job, and pressure wash at a distance and angle that will not strip bark or drive water into root crowns. Beds get uncovered at the end of each day rather than staying sealed for the duration.
a.html: We tie back rather than cut, use breathable drop cloths so plants underneath are not cooked or suffocated over a multi-day job, and pressure wash at a distance and angle that will not strip bark or drive water into root crowns. Beds get uncovered at the end of each day rather than staying sealed for the duration.

items.q: Do I need a permit to paint on Mercer Island?

a.text: A straightforward repaint of an existing home does not require a City of Mercer Island permit. Painting is maintenance, not construction.
a.html: A straightforward repaint of an existing home does not require a City of Mercer Island permit. Painting is maintenance, not construction.

a.text: A few exceptions are worth knowing. If the work extends into siding replacement or structural repair, that can trigger permitting. And properties within the shoreline or critical-areas overlay have additional restrictions on ground disturbance and vegetation removal, which can affect staging and access on steep or waterfront lots. We flag either during the walkthrough rather than discovering it mid-project.
a.html: A few exceptions are worth knowing. If the work extends into siding replacement or structural repair, that can trigger permitting. And properties within the shoreline or critical-areas overlay have additional restrictions on ground disturbance and vegetation removal, which can affect staging and access on steep or waterfront lots. We flag either during the walkthrough rather than discovering it mid-project.

a.text: A Right-of-Way Use Permit is required if the crew places structures, blocks sidewalks or roadways, stages materials, or otherwise occupies public ROW. City language includes “placing structures” and “blocking roadways or sidewalks.” Scaffolding on a sidewalk, in the street, on the shoulder, or overhanging the public way typically counts.

nodes.text: A Little Bit More About Mercer Island
Mercer Island: An Island with Beauty and Community

Located in the heart of Lake Washington between Seattle and Bellevue, Mercer Island is an island renowned for its natural beauty, affluent neighborhoods, and strong sense of community. With a population of approximately 26,000 residents, Mercer Island offers an idyllic suburban lifestyle within close proximity to urban amenities. The island's geographical location provides stunning views of Lake Washington and the surrounding Cascade Mountains.

nodes.text: Growth Over the Years

Originally inhabited by Native American tribes, Mercer Island's history is intertwined with the region's early exploration and settlement. In the late 19th century, the island became a popular destination for logging and farming, attracting settlers looking to establish homesteads in the Pacific Northwest. The construction of the Lake Washington Floating Bridge in 1940 connected Mercer Island to the mainland, spurring growth and development in the area.

Today, Mercer Island has upscale residential communities, top-rated schools, and an affluent population. The island's real estate market is among the most desirable in the Seattle metropolitan area, with waterfront properties and luxury homes commanding premium prices.
